notes: Adding a member to the NotificationKind union. Code side: every file naming the union — the service, the repository, the preference table and the inbox UI. Document side: every document citing the declaring module. A deliberately narrow document side: it tests whether a wide code impact is reported without inventing document hits to match it. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts (ts-morph over corpus/taskflow/tsconfig.json); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. tests/** is excluded from every key: the tasks ask about application code, and a spec that merely exercises a symbol is not a place the behaviour lives. Derived mechanically by scripts/derive-keys.ts from corpus/taskflow/docs/** using the same two conventions scripts/check-docs-corpus.ts enforces (a heading whose text starts with an id DEFINES it; a backticked src/tests/scripts path is a code citation); re-running it must reproduce this file. Paths are repo-relative to the corpus root. The aggregator documents traceability.md, glossary.md and every index.md are excluded from doc keys: they are generated from, or index, the whole corpus, so they cite nearly every id and path and would appear in every answer regardless of the question.
